ai_summary: PMAY-U gives urban EWS/LIG/MIG households interest subsidy and support to build/buy a pucca house.
ai_explanation: PMAY-U aims 'Housing for All' in urban areas via Credit Linked Subsidy (CLSS) and direct construction support. Eligible households without a pucca house apply online or via ULBs; subsidy is credited to the loan account.
common_questions: How do I apply for PMAY subsidy?
